name: Surface Build Decisions
summary: Surface consequential design choices and defaults before implementation begins.
description: Identify the smallest set of consequential product and technical decisions that should be made before building. Use when a plan appears ready but hidden defaults could create rework or irreversible behavior.
risk_reason: This skill surfaces consequential design choices and defaults before implementation begins; it does not treat a recommendation as approval.
refuses: It does not manufacture decisions merely to appear thorough.
It does not reopen settled choices without new contradictory evidence.
It does not treat a recommendation as approval.

operational.latency_reason: The skill surfaces consequential design choices and defaults before implementation begins, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
